why: Serie «Mito o no»: la fórmula del video de las 37 expresiones (13,5 millones de vistas) aplicada a la duda sobre un rostro natural. Objetivo: alcance y confianza de quienes temen el bótox.

problems: Hook text 'Botox, and you can still smile?' is awkward and sits on top of the woman's forehead, close to her face
Frames at 0.6, 1.9 and 3.2s are near-identical (same injection-marking shot), so the video feels static
Stock footage of a worried woman in a yellow shirt and a woman smiling in a bathroom mirror is generic and not tied to the med spa or a treatment room
Captions are fragmented ('is careful.', 'us.') and the disclaimer is tiny, so the text is hard to read
Marker-on-face shot looks clinical and unclear, with no visible botox result or spa setting
qa.fix: Replace the repeated marking shots and generic stock clips with varied real spa footage (consultation, injection, happy client with natural expression), place larger full-phrase captions away from faces, and finish with a branded end card with a bold GLOW CTA.
